author: pietroGru
body:
#### PR description:
This PR collects the work about the fix of Tracking-related DQM, done during the CMS Week (September 2026) and specifically the Track 1 Hackathon.

#### PR validation:
An example configuration is used to generate DQM files before and after the merge of this branch, confirming that the proposed fixes of range is applied.
title: DQM cleanup for tracking POG during the CMSWeek Hackathon Track 1
